name: Pointer Lock
plain: Hides and captures the mouse for games and 3D views.
meaning: Gives raw relative mouse movement with unlimited range while the cursor is hidden. With unadjustedMovement the site gets unaccelerated input, a small hardware hint.

access.prompt_ui: Browser shows an on-screen notice and Esc to exit; some platforms prompt on re-lock. Needs a gesture.

data.update: per mouse event (about 125 Hz or higher)

limits.headline: Can hide your mouse pointer and capture its movement for games or 3D views
limits.user_action: You click inside a game or 3D view
can: Hide the pointer and track raw mouse movement
Let you turn a camera or view without hitting the screen edge
Use unaccelerated mouse input if the site asks for it
cannot: Start without a click, tap or key press
Trap you; Esc always gets you out
Keep control after you switch tabs or apps
limits.differs: Chrome, Firefox, Safari on Mac and Android browsers support it. Safari on iPhone does not.

story.what_it_is: A page hides your mouse pointer and reads your raw movement, like in a shooter game.

marketing.name: Pointer Lock API
marketing.pitch: Describes a way for apps to capture the mouse and read how far it moves, used for games, 3D views and maps.

story.for_you: You click on a game and your mouse pointer disappears. You can turn endlessly with no screen edge stopping you. The browser shows a small note and Escape gives the pointer back.
story.for_makers: First person games, 3D viewers and cloud gaming need unlimited relative mouse movement. Makers can offer console quality aim on the web without installing anything.

use_cases.example: A browser shooter hides the pointer and uses raw mouse movement so you can spin the camera freely.
A cloud gaming service passes your raw mouse movement to the remote PC so aim feels right.
A 3D modeling web app locks the pointer while you orbit around an object.
A 3D globe or map site lets you drag without leaving the screen edge.
A remote desktop in the browser shows the host's pointer rather than yours.
Raw mouse deltas let a game study aim patterns, which also reveals cheaters.

abuse: Locking cursor to a scam page
